components.description: Quiet bottom navigation with an active surface.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:5px;padding:10px 22px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#e5e5dc)}.ds-nav button{font-family:Vazirmatn,sans-serif;font-size:13px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s;font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#30342d)}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{color:#52623d;background:#edeee5}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#efefe7}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--olive,#657349);outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav button,.ds-days button{transition:none;animation:none}}

narrative.northStar: A compact daily ritual with a lasting personal world
narrative.overview:
A compact daily ritual with a lasting personal world. Warm paper, graphite, olive, local Persian typography and fine separators keep the desktop companion quiet and personal. The approved authority is design/royesh-concept-v2.png for the main window and design/royesh-widget-v3.png for the card widget.

The implementation uses an open page rather than stacked statistic cards. English literary quotations introduce a serif voice alongside Persian UI text. Botanical raster material belongs to the forest; restrained SVG geometry belongs to the sky and optional lamp. The lamp's local glow is functional illustration, not a decorative page gradient.
keyCharacteristics: Compact cream and olive desktop surfaces.
Persian RTL interface with deliberate LTR quotation and calendar regions.
Fine separators, restrained rounding and inline statistics.
Local imagery and fonts; optional personal media and living worlds.

rules.name: Quiet Accent
rules.body: Use olive for actions, selected states and growth; keep the surrounding page on warm paper.

rules.name: Two Reading Directions
rules.body: Keep Persian controls RTL and English quotation text LTR; do not mirror literary content with the interface.

rules.name: Flat Page, Lifted Dialog
rules.body: Use separators and tonal fields for ordinary surfaces; reserve the diffuse shadow for dialogs.

dos: Do preserve Persian RTL reading order, Solar Hijri labels and explicit LTR English quotations.
Do keep real instructions in empty states and confine synthetic history to tests and visual verification.
Do retain aspect ratio and explicit fit/crop controls for personal media.
Do retain keyboard focus, semantic status labels and reduced-motion behavior.
Do carry embedded prompt provenance with shipping raster assets.
donts: Don't add a permanent media sidebar, oversized hero or statistic cards to the compact main surface.
Don't introduce remote runtime fonts, imagery or telemetry.
Don't use color alone to convey daily status.
Don't apply decorative gradients to page chrome; the optional illustrated lamp has a localized light gradient.
